Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly identifying the "first National Geographic short on YouTube" as "Human Origins 101" (released in 2018). This identification is factually wrong; National Geographic released shorts (typically 1-3 minutes) on YouTube much earlier, starting around 2012 (e.g., "The Ocean" series or "Wild" shorts). By anchoring the entire search strategy to the wrong video, the Orchestrator failed to find the correct content where "#9" would be defined. This initial misidentification led to a cascade of failed searches for transcripts and details of a video that was not the target of the user's query, preventing the team from ever reaching the Monterey Bay Aquarium website to find the correct length data.
